messages:
Emma: FYI — customer (AcmeCorp) opened SEV2. After yesterday's rollout their TypeScript codegen now fails to compile in CI. Example attached.

Raj: Do we have a ticket/link and CI logs?

Emma: Ticket: https://acme.atlassian.io/browse/ACME-1234

Emma: Generated snippet from API:

```ts
export function transform(input) {
  return input.map(x => x.value) // previously used toPascalCase helper, now missing
}
```

Emma: Build error from their CI: TS2304: Cannot find name 'toPascalCase'. Also 'Record' used without import in other files.

deploy-bot: rolled out model-ref v3.1.0 to prod at 2026-03-16T22:05:00Z

Sophia: sounds like the model altered code patterns / removed helpers. Can you paste the exact prompt, model id, and request payload?

Emma: Prompt: "Write a TypeScript utility to transform API responses into typed records, include helper toPascalCase and JSDoc." Payload: { model: "redwood-code-3b", temperature: 0.0, max_tokens: 400 }

Oliver: assigning to eng-ml to investigate. I'll run a bisection between v3.0.7 and v3.1.0. @Sophia please add failing examples to the eval corpus.

Sophia: adding them now to the 'codegen-regressions' eval. If confirmed, we should pin the customer's routing to v3.0.7 and block rollout.

Raj: Customer asks for ETA — mitigation options?

Oliver: Quick mitigation: pin AcmeCorp to model-ref v3.0.7 per-account routing. I can do that with infra; estimate ~30m to apply and validate.

Emma: Please proceed and keep CS updated so I can reply to the customer.

customer-support-bot: ticket ACME-1234 updated by Emma. Status: triaged.

Oliver: Update: pinned AcmeCorp to v3.0.7, verified CI run in customer sandbox is now green. Will follow up with a postmortem and model eval.

Emma: Thanks team — I'll close the loop with the customer and request an incident RCA. :white_check_mark:
